close_reason: post-write duplicate detection added; race documented; storage must enforce uniqueness
description: space.rs handle_space_join: the already_member check on new_members uses the members list fetched from the Space before the invite.uses increment. If the backend is called concurrently for the same (account_id, space_id) by two requests, both will pass the already_member check and both will push a duplicate member entry. This is the same TOCTOU race as JMAP-4ii.24 (VacationResponse) but for Space membership. The fix requires atomic compare-and-swap at the backend level or a backend-level add_member operation.
title: Space/join member-already-check uses stale members list from before invite-uses increment
